artifact.observed_symptom: Global chart view shows floating black unlit tree silhouette in ocean east of Puerto Rico/Fajardo and partial silhouette southwest, consistent with leaked physical forest entity rendered under global map camera.

proven_causal_chain.creation_defaults: Grass::Init (grass.cpp:244-247) unconditionally registers in EXECUTE (0) and REALIZE (1). Land location (Location::LoadGrass, location.cpp:845-865) relies on these and erases on location unload.
proven_causal_chain.sea_creation_leak: Sea_CreateRegionGrass (sea.c:1789-1791) added SEA_EXECUTE (2) and SEA_REALIZE (3) without LayerDelObject(EXECUTE/REALIZE, grass), leaving duplicate layer membership.
proven_causal_chain.worldmap_leak: Sea_ResidentSuspend (sea.c:474-479) freezes sea layers and unfreezes EXECUTE/REALIZE for worldmap. Grass::Realize dispatched on every worldmap frame, rendering physical island forest with map camera.

fix.delta: LayerDelObject(EXECUTE, grass); LayerDelObject(REALIZE, grass); immediately after CreateEntity
fix.pattern_parity: Matches existing layer transfer pattern used by WhrSky, WhrRain, WhrLightning, WhrSun, AISea
